CustomField.description: This traveller's own feedback link, assembled from their booking's number and their Survey_Secret__c, the same way Booking__c.Survey_Link__c is built for a main contact. The base address comes from the Gx_Feedback_Setting__mdt Default record, so staging and production each resolve to their own site. Blank until GxFeedbackDispatch has invited this traveller. It is what the team can copy when a guest asks for their link again.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: This traveller's personal feedback link. Generated automatically; do not edit.
CustomField.label: Survey Link
